data.name: label10.Text
data.value:
If the database engine you're connecting to resides on this machine, please select the corresponding database service from the list below.
For example, if you are connecting to MariaDB on this machine, select MariaDB in the list below. If you're connecting to a remote database, leave this empty.
Altimail Server will instruct Windows that it is dependent on the database engine you have selected. This ensures that the database engine is up and running before Altimail Server starts.
